P01.drivers: Very broad, heavy, barrel trunk with a large belly and thick back in profile; lumpy surface; thick pillar-like legs; arms short relative to the bulk. Reads as an obese or heavy-set human, though a stocky race such as a dwarf is possible
limb_cues: arms appear short against the trunk width

P02.drivers: In profile the upper trunk is bulbous and egg-shaped, with strong rounded swelling front and back, over a narrow waist and pelvis. Limbs are very thin with knobby knee and calf swellings. The way the segments relate does not match ordinary human thinness
axial_cues: narrow pelvis relative to chest depth

P03.drivers: Typical slim adult, with mildly wider hips and smooth proportions

P05.drivers: Average adult with a slightly soft midsection

P06.drivers: Average adult with typical shoulder-to-hip ratio

P07.drivers: Slim adult with somewhat wider hips and thighs; ordinary

P08.drivers: Fuller average adult with a slightly heavier trunk and buttock; within the ordinary range

P09.drivers: Same pattern as P02: a bulbous, rounded upper trunk in profile, a narrow pinched waist and pelvis, very thin limbs with knobby knee and calf swellings, and a broad shoulder yoke in front over a narrow lower body
axial_cues: ovoid upper trunk with strong back and chest bulge
limb_cues: knee bulge with shin set back

P10.drivers: Average adult, with a slightly long trunk and broad shoulders; ordinary

P11.drivers: Very wide, flat, blocky trunk with a heavy belly and deep back in profile; lumpy surface; thick legs. Same type as P01. Reads as a heavy or obese human; a stocky race is possible
axial_cues: belly and deep back in profile
limb_cues: arms short relative to trunk width

groups.label: heavy, broad, blocky trunk (obese human or stocky race)
bulbous upper trunk, pinched waist, spindly knobby limbs

distinguishing_features: I am confident in only one clear non-human group, P02 and P09. They have an ovoid, bulging upper trunk over a narrow waist and pelvis, and thin limbs with discrete knee and calf knobs. P01 and P11 form a separate, clearly different type: wide, rectangular, heavy trunks on thick columnar legs. I classed P01 and P11 as extreme humans (B) rather than as a race, but if they are a race, they are easy to tell apart from P02 and P09 by bulk versus spindliness and by the trunk shape (block versus egg).
